strategyReview: What is working: clean live WEEKEND_HL_FUNDING_REVERSION_LONG remains the workhorse (346/500 live wins, +0.31% avg; 188/253 shadows), monotonic arb is eligible live, and manual IV-touch rich NO continues to show strong per-trade value. What is failing: one-touch/cap-edge shadow variants are being mis-graded as spot-decline calls or are bleeding via wide-spread ETH/BTC premium shorts; single-threshold funding reversion shadows (CBRS/MU/AAPL) are whipsawing; HYPE-based BTC confirmation and listed-IV momentum confirmation are now clearly invalid; and countertrend funding shorts into positive trends continue to stop out.

failureClusters.theme: One-touch NO mis-graded as spot calls
failureClusters.evidence: H-534 is 2/14 with 4 unscorable tests; recent ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO shadow/live losses include -22.3%, -17.99%, -9.62% on ETH and -6.25% on BTC, while the traded edge is really in contract premium, not a >2% spot decline.
failureClusters.recommendation: Re-author gold/ETH/BTC cap-edge and one-touch NO theses as contract PnL over 2-3 days, not spot-move predictions; keep edge-size gates and avoid spotting a spot-direction target.

failureClusters.evidence: CBRS shadow 46%, MU 31%, AAPL 53%; many losses show funding pinned near 5.5% or dropping from positive, indicating plain < -10 entries are not true stress regimes.
failureClusters.recommendation: Require true weekend timing, extreme percentile within the asset's recent 7d range, and preferably already-positive 24h funding change before taking any funding-reversion long.

failureClusters.theme: HYPE confirmation and listed-IV confirmation are false signals
failureClusters.evidence: cross_asset_iv_compression_vol_expansion is 9/25 and btc_listed_iv_momentum_confirmation is 4/16; truth records list both assumptions as learned-invalid, with wins concentrated in a few strong trend days rather than a durable edge.
failureClusters.recommendation: Stop authoring HYPE-confirms-BTC-long and rising-listed-IV-confirms-BTC-long variants; retire or disable these confirmation approaches pending a fundamentally different mechanism.

failureClusters.theme: Countertrend funding shorts into positive trend
failureClusters.evidence: Recent FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG shorts GOLD -1.01% and BTC -1.83% stopped, both with short_blocked_by_positive_trend and above-trend/momentum metrics positive; signal is 49% win and -0.44% avg.
failureClusters.recommendation: Strengthen positive-trend filters before any funding-extreme short, and consider expanding disabledAssets to remove assets where trend consistently negates the funding signal.

failureClusters.theme: Polymarket proxy shorts diverge from Hyperliquid signal
failureClusters.evidence: FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG_PM_PROXY_SHORT GOLD lost -2.3% while the source comparison closed +0.91% and was labeled opposite_direction; family shadows are 3/22, -2.85% avg.
failureClusters.recommendation: Do not use Polymarket proxy shorts as a substitute for Hyperliquid funding mean reversion; the PM contract does not track the funding source move closely enough.

newHypotheses.description: Outcome-panel NO edge: when any listed contract offers a sell-YES edge below 1pt and the cheapest YES ask is in the 35-65c band, buy NO / sell YES across all assets for 7 days. The panel shows the premium is systematically too high and decays over a 7d window.
newHypotheses.prediction: Buying NO / selling YES on these contracts is profitable over 7 days.

newHypotheses.description: Outcome-panel NO edge: when the cheapest YES ask is in the 35-65c band across all assets, buy NO / sell YES for 7 days. This is the broader panel condition behind FIND-0066 and has a positive holdout.
newHypotheses.prediction: Buying NO / selling YES on these contracts is profitable over 7 days.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-539: require the CBRS funding stress to occur on a genuine weekend and be extreme relative to the recent 7d range, and require funding to already be rising off its low. This avoids the whipsaw 2.3% -> -13.4% and 5.5% pinned prints that made a plain sub -10 entry fail.
newHypotheses.prediction: CBRS perp spot gains >2% within 2 days when weekend funding is in the bottom 15% of its 7d range and already reversing higher.

newHypotheses.description: Re-author the gold one-touch cap-edge signal as a contract-premium fade rather than a spot-decline call. The prior H-534 demanded GOLD spot fall >2% in 2 days, but the tradeable edge was in the NO contract price, which moved only a few cents around 0.93-0.945; contract PnL should be evaluated directly.
newHypotheses.prediction: Short YES / long NO on these gold upside one-touch contracts is profitable over 3 days as overpriced YES premium deflates.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-537: restrict AAPL funding reversion to true weekend days and require the funding print to be in the bottom 15% of the recent 7d range, not merely below -10. This removes the any-day 10.4% -> 5.5% and 11.2% -> 5.5% non-stress losses.
newHypotheses.prediction: AAPL perp gains >2% within 2 days when weekend funding is in the bottom 15% of its 7d range and already reversing higher.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 12/26 scorable tests and only 46% wins; plain CBRS funding < -10 does not identify a reliable normalization regime. Losses show funding flattening or re-dropping rather than normalizing.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A standalone CBRS funding reading below -10% reliably normalizes and forces a >2% spot gain within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 10/19 scorable tests; the any-day threshold allows prints around 5.5% or mildly positive readings that never represented weekend funding stress, so the entry is not a reversion setup.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: AAPL funding below -10% on any day rapidly normalizes and yields a >2% spot gain.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 5/16 scorable tests; MU funding < -10 is too weak a condition and often catches pinned/choppy funding around 5.5%, not a genuine immediate normalization opportunity.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Extreme negative MU funding (< -10%) outside true weekend hours rapidly normalizes and produces >2% spot gain.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 2/14 scorable and 4 unscorable; the hypothesis was scored on the wrong instrument. The cap edge is a rich-NO contract observation, so using spot decline >2% as success produced noise while the contract prices moved only a few cents.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large underlying-cap edge on gold upside one-touch NO contracts reliably predicts a >2% spot decline within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 4/16 scorable and 25% win; rising listed IV alongside spot momentum did not lead to further BTC gains. Several resolved examples were effectively short/mean-reverting outcomes, showing IV expansion was more hedging demand than continuation signal.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Spot momentum confirmed by rising options IV leads to further >2% BTC gains within 3-7 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 9/25 scorable and only 36% win; HYPE above SMA with stable OI did not produce durable BTC continuation and was repeatedly recorded as learned-invalid. The setup only won during a few large trend days, not as a repeatable filter.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: HYPE spot above SMA with stable OI is an independent confirmation of durable BTC upside rather than a late-stage risk-on echo.

journalEntry: Tonight's main cleanup is instrument and regime discipline. The one-touch/cap-edge families are not spot-directional trades; they are contract premium fades and must be authored and judged on contract PnL. Funding reversion shadows need true weekend timing and relative extremity, not flat funding thresholds. HYPE-confirms-BTC and listed-IV-confirms-BTC now have enough negative evidence to stop authoring close variants. Ranked panel findings FIND-0065/0066 are the strongest new contract-NO discoveries and should be shadow-tested cleanly. No risk parameter changes are warranted on current evidence.
